titles.title: We Offer This Bread To You

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
The Word incarnate sacrificed
His life upon the cross

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines: And willed that he should die for one and all

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines: And through this sacrifice he gave to men what men had lost

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines: Through that fateful deed which brought about his fall

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
We offer this bread to you, O Lord
We offer this wine

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
In union with Christ our Lord and God
We offer you praise
We offer you praise

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
O let your Spirit come upon these
Gifts of bread and wine

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines: To sanctify this offering in your name

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
And send your advocate to gather all
men into one

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines: That in union we may priase your holy name

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
So in this Eucharistic feast
We call to mind the love

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines: Which God revealed through Christ his only Son

verse.name: v3c
verse.lines:
The Spirit came upon him as a sign
from God above

verse.name: v3d
verse.lines: That his mission in the world has just begun

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines: He called the twelve together and he gave them this command

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines: "You must do this in memory of me

verse.name: v4c
verse.lines: Each time you eat this food you eat my Body, drink my Blood

verse.name: v4d
verse.lines: And you offer praise to God the Trinity"
